must_not: Sends another message to Misdelivery collections, Hartwold Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Collection of the wrong parcel does not fulfil the reporting customer’s own order.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-027: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed. 42 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's.
